description: Three headlines from one vendor blog is one signal, not three: sources must span at least two distinct domains.

input.topic: Direct Lake and semantic model changes

rubric.condition: The set of network locations parsed from all source_url values has at least 2 distinct members.
The output contains the literal substring learn.microsoft.com, which was supplied as a seed source.
The signals array contains at least 3 items even after de-duplicating by domain.
